repairs.name: yaw_spindle

repairs.name: tilt_trunnion

selection.selector: N.z < -0.215, excluding cable; include round base, lower black tube and collar. All otherwise unassigned non-cable faces below collar stay here.
selection.reason: Base and lower sleeve are one fixed reference for this preview, not a claim of a bolted floor attachment.

selection.selector: Reflective narrow tube and control housing: -0.215 <= N.z < 0.135, near pole centerline N.x=-0.095, N.y=-0.02+0.10*(N.z+0.10); exclude cable and button. Include stationary lower neck up to yaw plane.
selection.reason: Nested tube/collar suggests axial sliding; control housing follows upper tube.

selection.selector: Rear support behind grille, N.z>=0.135 and N.z<0.29, approximately abs(N.x+0.095)<0.045 and N.y>0.005; retain only narrow support surfaces by adjacency to neck, exclude motor shell and circular head.
selection.reason: A narrow support at rear carries the head; yaw axis estimate uses support junction, not head obliqueness.

selection.selector: All circular head surfaces centered approximately C=(-0.11,-0.045,0.315), N.z>0.135, except rotor and yaw support: grille wires, perimeter, front branded cover, rear motor shell and handle.
selection.reason: Grille and branded cover remain stationary with head while enclosed broad blades rotate.

selection.selector: Within circular head C=(-0.11,-0.045,0.315), radius <0.17 in plane normal a=(0,-0.955,0.2966): select broad paddle surfaces in the middle depth layer between front/rear grille, including connected blade hub. Exclude thin radial grille wires, front logo cap and rear motor shell using local thickness, normals, projected broad-patch continuity and front/rear depth. Use all visible broad blade patches without assuming blade count.
selection.reason: Broad interior lobes support a common rotor, but overlapping neural grille requires depth-aware face selection.

selection.selector: Highest pale convex button patch on front control housing within -0.08<N.z<0.10, abs(N.x+0.095)<0.035; select contiguous cap faces and sidewall by projected patch boundary, not surrounding printed glyphs.
selection.reason: One independently movable representative control button; other visible button functions remain explicitly unresolved.

review_requirements: Construction-only inspection: account for every native face exactly once across rigid owners and cable skin, retain rest geometry/UV/PBR, and inspect rotor/guard/support/cable ownership in front and side views. Treat coordinate thresholds as region seeds; preserve full identified paddle patches and reserve yaw-support faces before assigning the head complement. Record only actual connector additions within the approved area caps.

Using static joint transforms only, inspect visible attachment at minimum, midpoint and maximum declared finite travel for head_yaw, head_tilt, height_slide and button_press. Confirm the head and rotor inherit yaw/tilt/height, the housing follows height, the cap moves inward relative to housing, and the base stays fixed. Keep spindle/trunnion attachment and telescopic overlap visibly continuous using only approved bounded connectors. These are construction pose inspections, not physical endpoint, contact or trajectory tests.

Inspect exported MJCF and interaction metadata: blade_spin has limited=false, no range or limits envelope and no actuator angular stop. With parameter transforms, inspect representative non-equivalent rotor poses and unwrapped angle handling through the declared 4*pi preview span; visible broad blades move while grille, branded front cover and motor shell remain fixed relative to head_shell. Do not implement spin by rotating only an invisible frame or by wrapping/clamping accumulated angle.

Construct the coarse cable flex and a nonempty exclusive native skin binding. Use the planned bounded 0.03 m parameter displacement to show spatially varying visible cable deformation with the outlet pinned to upper_stand, preserving supported skin offsets and rest appearance. This is a nonrigid construction preview, not a gravity/load/recovery experiment; do not execute the inherited gravity_settle strategy.

Save usable GLB, editable Blender source, MJCF, manifest and interactive metadata early, retaining all planned controls and declared omissions. Publish after construction with physics_status=not_tested and physics_attempts=0. Never invoke physics.py, simulate, verify_integration, mj_step, physical trajectories, contact/load/endpoint tests or full validation/critic loops, and do not fabricate their reports.

interaction_coverage.label: Blade rotation
interaction_coverage.reason: Broad blades within stationary guard suggest rotary airflow mechanism. Unlimited editable rotor joint.

interaction_coverage.label: Head yaw oscillation
interaction_coverage.reason: Estimated support-axis yaw; limited oscillation is distinct from continuous blade spin.

interaction_coverage.label: Head tilt
interaction_coverage.reason: Rear head/support attachment supports estimated lateral trunnion for aiming; bounded construction despite hidden hardware.

interaction_coverage.label: Height adjustment
interaction_coverage.reason: Reflective nested tube and collar support telescoping travel; range is an editable prior.

interaction_coverage.label: Representative control press
interaction_coverage.reason: Small convex cap suggests inward constrained travel; 2 mm is an explicit button-travel prior based on cap scale, not collision convenience.

interaction_coverage.label: Attached cable bending
interaction_coverage.reason: Curved hanging cord needs visible nonrigid binding; construction preview only, no dynamics.

interaction_coverage.label: Other control buttons and electrical functions
interaction_coverage.reason: Additional caps and labels are visible but exact electrical mapping and independent cap boundaries are uncertain at native resolution.
interaction_coverage.attempt_plan: Retain remaining caps on housing; first candidate supplies one representative press. A later explicitly requested construction can partition additional independently identified caps; no full control-panel functionality claimed.

approximation_gaps.reason: Native head has thin fragmented grille and overlapping paddle surfaces. Retain PBR and faces; no reconstruction of blade count or hidden motor. Bound added geometry to approved connectors only.
Simple base cylinder, stand capsules, sparse head rim and motor proxies; detailed grille/blade clearance and all contacts untested. Tolerance policy does not imply physical pass.
Coarse cable flex/skin and bounded parameter bending only. Material stiffness, floor interaction and elastic recovery are untested and not claimed.
